explanation: At D2 it tracks the state shown: about 10 when S1 is reached and 0-2 when S2 is reached, whichever action was chosen. At D1 it reflects the last trial state and reward: about 2-3 after a rewarded S1, 4-5 after a rewarded rare S2 (chose a1), 5-6 after an unrewarded S1, about 7 after a rewarded common S2 (chose a2), and 8-10 after an unrewarded S2 or a run of losses; at GO it sits at 6-7, falling to 5 after an unrewarded trial and rising to 8 when the agent switches to a2 or right after a rewarded rare trial.
